user.title: Domat MW240 serial bus
user.description: These settings configure Home Assistant only and do not reprogram module communications. They must match the existing modules. No serial connection, probing, or writes occur in this flow; startup discovers identity read-only. All write permissions are independent and disabled by default.

data.name: Bus name (stable identifier)
data.allow_timing_changes: Allow applying travel-time changes to RAM
data.allow_eeprom_save: Allow permanent EEPROM save (tested firmware 17 only)

data_description.name: Use a unique lowercase slug, for example office_blinds. This is the legacy entity identity namespace and cannot be changed later.
data_description.port: Use a dedicated serial device path, preferably /dev/serial/by-id/.... Do not share it with another integration.
data_description.baudrate: Must match the existing module baud rate; this does not change the modules.
data_description.parity: Must match the existing module parity: N (none), E (even), or O (odd).
data_description.stopbits: Must match the existing module stop-bit setting.
data_description.poll_interval: Read-only polling interval, from 1 to 60 seconds.
data_description.timeout: Serial response timeout, from 0.1 to 2 seconds.
data_description.command_ttl: Discard expired queued commands after 1 to 15 seconds.
data_description.allow_commands: Disabled by default. Enabling this permits physical blind movement from Home Assistant.
data_description.allow_timing_changes: Disabled by default. This separately permits applying staged travel-time changes to module RAM; it does not save them permanently.
data_description.allow_eeprom_save: Disabled by default. Permanent save commits all RAM configuration, not only travel times. Limited to tested firmware 17; EEPROM has limited write endurance. Enabling permission does not itself perform a save.

modules.title: Modules on this bus
modules.description:
Enter one module per line, for example:
23: Window name
24: Another

Use 1 to 247 modules with unique integer addresses from 1 to 247. Address 0 is broadcast and is never allowed. Names are editable; module addresses identify devices. This list does not scan or reprogram hardware. Identity is discovered read-only at startup.

error.invalid_config: Check the settings. Use a nonempty lowercase bus slug, a serial path, supported communication settings, and values within the displayed limits.
error.invalid_modules: Enter 1 to 247 modules, one per line: 23: Window name. Use unique integer addresses from 1 to 247 and nonempty names. Broadcast 0, signed or fractional addresses, and duplicates are not allowed.
error.serial_port_in_use: This serial port (or an alias of it) is already assigned to another Domat MW240 bus. Choose a dedicated port.
error.already_configured: A bus with this stable name already exists. Edit its options instead.

abort.already_configured: This bus is already configured. Existing UI settings and permissions were kept unchanged. Edit the existing entry to make changes.
abort.already_in_progress: Configuration of this bus is already in progress. Finish or cancel the other flow first.
abort.serial_port_in_use: This serial port (or an alias of it) is already assigned to another Domat MW240 bus. Use a dedicated port.
abort.invalid_config: The imported bus configuration is invalid. Check its name, serial settings, unique module addresses (1 to 247), and configured module count (1 to 247).
